name: Ezdan Holding Group Q.P.S.C.
summary: Ezdan Holding Group Q.P.S.C., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the management and rental of real estate properties in Qatar. It operates through Residential and Commercial Properties, Hotel and Suites, and Malls segments. The company offers hotel, real estate, maintenance works, and entertainment services. It also engages in the development, ownership, trade, and rental of residential and commercial real estate properties; development and management of shopping malls; and management of hotels, hotel apartments, suites, and restaurants. Ezdan Holding Group Q.P.S.C. was founded in 1960 and is based in Doha, Qatar.
